added: Free-text entry recognises more everyday phrasings: a hey with a starting pair and shoulder ("half hey, ladies start by the right"), "N" and "neighbours" for neighbors, and "allemande left 1 1/2 with neighbor".
fixed: Free-text entry no longer turns a line like "ladies chain over and back" or "neighbors swing 16" into a figure with the wrong beats and the rest hidden in a note: a leftover that is only another move, "and back" or a bare number is now marked unparsed. "give and take" still needs a giver and a target.
